words.gloss: incompatibility (with one's body or other foods)

literal: If one eats, with moderation, food that is without incompatibility, there is no harm to life.
translation: If a person eats with moderation food that is compatible with their body, there will be no harm to their life.
modern: உடலுக்கு ஒத்துப்போகாத தன்மை இல்லாத உணவை, அளவுடன் கட்டுப்படுத்தி உண்டால், உயிருக்கு எந்தத் துன்பமும் இல்லை.
explanation: This couplet highlights two essential rules of healthy eating: compatibility and moderation. The term 'māṟupāṭu illāta uṇṭi' refers to food that does not conflict with one's physical constitution or with other foods eaten together. The phrase 'maṟuttu uṇṇiṉ' advises eating with self-restraint, rejecting excess even when the food is agreeable. By choosing compatible food and eating it in moderate quantities, one can prevent illness and ensure a long, healthy life.
